review.notes: All 659 OCR lines were read and compared against the extracted text layer of the 42-page PDF; pages 16, 20, 22, 23, 24 (reference/footnote crops at 150-300 dpi) and the tops of appendix pages 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 36, 38, 40 (150 dpi) were additionally rendered and visually checked. Body pages 3-11 and 13, 17-19, 21, 25-26 were only spot-checked, and Tables 1-3 were triaged but not verified cell-by-cell, so coverage is partial. The bibliography's "Qwen2. 5-vl", "Seed1. 5-vl" and the broken URL "https://arxiv. org/abs/2403, 3163" in reference [43] were verified at 300 dpi as typos the PDF itself prints (reference [43] also shows "arxiv. org" with a space) and were left unchanged, as were the PDF's own "OminiSpatial" and "WebVoyager Some" strings.

unresolved.evidence: The PDF prints each appendix case's Prompt/Model Response transcript as real text below its screenshot (confirmed in the PDF text layer and in the rendered tops of pages 29-30), but the OCR kept only the screenshots and figure captions for sections A.1 (response body), A.2-A.8 (Figures 8-14), A.10 (Figure 16), A.12 (Figure 18) and A.14 (Figure 20). Transcribing these long Chinese/English transcripts needs a dedicated pass; the dropped section headings are already restored by patches above.

Two long author-list runs in reference [47] lost inter-name spaces and use full-width commas: from "E. Buchatskaya，Y.Miao,M.Elhawaty,..." through "...A.Singhal" (p.23) and from "...Choquette-Chooy，Y．Li，T．Lu，..." through "...J.Lee，" (p.24), roughly 330 names total. The printed list is properly spaced (verified at 300 dpi); a full re-transcription from the page render is needed. Boundary tokens and two misreads are already fixed by patches.

Tables 1-3 are exported as HTML tables whose cells concatenate printed sub-cells (e.g. A.9's "Prompt: 解题Model Response:" with a stray "<", Table 3's "WebVoyageSom" flattening the printed superscript marker, "GeoBench1"/"OSWorld2" gluing footnote markers). The text-layer column order interleaves, so cell-level values require a visual page-by-page pass before changing recorded numbers.
